purpose: Read retained graphics logs after BOOT6 reaches LSC/spinner but Lomiri aborts for gralloc-mapper
queries: 11 fixed log queries: existing tails plus first64KiB of the same USC file; bounded LightDM/persistent-journal metadata inventories remain unchanged.
guards: Pinned local tools and ADB version
Pinned prepared RECOVERY prefix and exact current BOOT6 prefix
Raw userdata ext4 already mounted at /data
Canonical directory chain and regular file; symlink/FIFO rejected
validation_limits: Mount tables and raw-device readlink responses are simulated; no handset accessed.
Version3 tests execute BusyBox/linker/libraries from the hash-pinned original TWRP recovery under QEMU, not the phone kernel.
Initial version1 used the normal BOOT BusyBox, missing the TWRP stat compile-option difference.
Native Windows CMD and Python PE execution was not tested.
Missing or retained old logs do not establish current service state; collection success is not a graphical boot.

original_test_summary.raw_mount_boundary: fixture only; no handset, mount or writes
original_test_summary.binary_identity_limit: Normal BOOT ARM64 BusyBox was exercised, not the active TWRP BusyBox binary/configuration.

handset_result.classification: Collector compatibility defect; no proof of absent graphics logs or new handset failure.

correction.metadata: Use BusyBox stat -t, explicitly advertised by the actual recovery usage.
correction.result: Distinguish optional absence from unsafe path, read/metadata failure and zero collected logs.
correction.scope: Same fixed bounded log paths; phone remains unchanged in TWRP. No extra Ubuntu attempt is required.
correction.tested_reproduction: Exact recovery stat -c returns unsupported-option error; stat -t and guarded log/inventory reads pass.

version2_test_summary.raw_mount_boundary: fixture only; no handset, mount or writes
version2_test_summary.initial_inventory_fixture_timeout: The first exact-recovery QEMU run passed assertions but one inventory fixture exceeded20s; fixture timeout raised to60s for emulator overhead. Real ADB query limit remains45s. Complete rerun passed20/20.

version2_handset_result.fscrypt_source_reason: ubuntu-touch-session has no errexit; initializes unencrypted target and conditionally selects encrypted target after fscrypt probe. Negative encryption probe does not stop it.
version2_handset_result.session_target_dependency: unencrypted target Requires+After lomiri-full-greeter Type=notify; mapper abort prevents readiness.
version2_handset_result.interpretation: Partial collection confirms the existing mapper failure. The USC omission is a collector transport-limit bug; it is not a new phone fault.
version2_handset_result.final_lightdm_stop: Last retained LightDM cycle receives SIGTERM from PID1 and exits cleanly. Cause of the stop is not identified by these files.

correction_v3.remote_read_scope: Retain512KiB tails; add first64KiB of the same USC log for initial loader configuration.
correction_v3.transport_bound: Allow at most2 transported bytes per remotely requested byte to account for LF to CRLF. Preserve received text without destructive newline normalization.
correction_v3.adb_mode: Retain working shell transport; do not require -T, which can reject legacy adbd without shell_v2.
correction_v3.scope: No new BOOT, mount, reboot or phone file write.
correction_v3.validation: 24/24 tests pass. Exact TWRP BusyBox fixtures verify prefix and tail separately; host transport fixtures accept512KiB expanded to1MiB CRLF, preserveCRLF, and reject raw/decoded overflow.
correction_v3.transport_cause_limit: The extra CR per LF is observed in received bytes. The exact origin (PTY or Windows text mode) has not been isolated; native Windows v3 execution is untested.

test_summary.raw_mount_boundary: fixture only; no handset, mount or writes

confirmed.root_lsc_renderer: ARM Mali-G76, OpenGL ES3.2, Android EGL1.4
confirmed.libminisf: Optional and explicitly tolerated: it only prevents fake SurfaceFlinger startup. Driver initializes EGL/GPU after message.
confirmed.greeter: Repeated mapper abort persists; no preceding HIDL transport/dlopen/permission error in supplied USC head/tail.
confirmed.nonroot_user_session: Lomiri fails before notify readiness. System compositor repeatedly becomes READY.
confirmed.broken_promise: USC head first instance19:50:42.727629, roughly68s after initialLSC start19:49:34.322412; same period asLightDM greeter teardown. This is downstream connection loss, not evidence of initial mappercause.

negative_fix_assessments.install_libminisf: Not justified; GPU path already works and source log explicitly handles absence.
negative_fix_assessments.replace_or_reflash_vendor: Not justified; root GPU path loads and renders successfully.
negative_fix_assessments.change_fscrypt: Not justified; unencrypted probe is expected and targetfailure followsLomiri abort.
negative_fix_assessments.change_pidfd_kernel: Not justified; LightDM tolerates ENOSYS and initializes compositor/session.

version3_handset_result.scope_limit: Prefix and tail are bounded portions of retained USC. The middle of the file and persistent journal binaries are not read. File identities do not independently date a retained attempt.
